## InitOptions.cliPackageJson property

File URL of an installed CLI package's `package.json`<!-- -->. Defaults to the CLI release metadata shipped with core. The CLI command supplies its own manifest.

**Signature:**

```typescript
cliPackageJson?: URL;
```
